# ZenID

> Your local identity workspace.

ZenID is a free, privacy-first professional identity workspace. It helps people
create ATS-friendly resumes, build public portfolios from explicitly selected
information, and fill or visually sign PDFs locally in a web browser. No ZenID
account is required for these core workflows. Private workspace data stays in
the visitor's browser.

## Core workflows

- [Turkish CV preparation](https://getzenid.com/tr/cv-hazirlama/): Create ATS-friendly CV versions and export selectable PDFs.
- [English resume builder](https://getzenid.com/en/resume-builder/): Build focused resumes from one reusable professional profile.
- [Turkish portfolio preparation](https://getzenid.com/tr/portfolyo-hazirlama/): Choose what becomes public and export a static portfolio site.
- [English portfolio builder](https://getzenid.com/en/portfolio-builder/): Build a provider-neutral portfolio with explicit privacy controls.
- [Turkish PDF editing](https://getzenid.com/tr/pdf-duzenleme/): Fill PDFs and add visual marks locally.
- [English private PDF editor](https://getzenid.com/en/private-pdf-editor/): Fill and visually sign PDFs in the browser.

## Product boundaries

- Canonical origin: https://getzenid.com/
- Private `.zenid` project files are user-owned local backups.
- Public portfolio packages contain only information selected for publication.
- ZenPDF visual signatures are not certificate-backed digital signatures.
- ZenID does not promise search ranking and does not expose a project-data backend.
- `zenid-mcp` is an optional local MCP server run by the user's own agent
  client over stdio. It makes no network request, ZenID holds no model-provider
  key, and no user data reaches ZenID. It may rewrite resume wording, must use a
  separate reported tool to change a factual claim, and can never widen what a
  portfolio publishes.
